verdict.rationale: Unit's docs show it is not itself a bank. It is a platform that works with one or multiple partner banks, holds deposit and wallet accounts in FBO structures, and connects to the Federal Reserve on behalf of those partner banks. That tells a founder the charter sits with partner banks, not Unit. Missing for 10: names of the specific partner banks holding the charter, how customer funds and ledgers are protected or reconciled if Unit fails, FDIC pass-through insurance details, and independent corroboration.
